rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a line placed under text for emphasis, italics, or a hyperlink.

example.english: Adding an underline to this text makes it easier to see that it is a key point.
example.traditional: 呢段字加條底線，就容易睇到係重點。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 zi6 gaa1 tiu4 dai2 sin3 zau6 jung4 ji6 tai2 dou2 hai6 zung6 dim2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for literally drawing a line beneath text.

example.english: The teacher told me to underline the key points.
example.traditional: 老師叫我喺重點下面畫底線。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 hai2 zung6 dim2 haa6 min6 waa6 dai2 sin3

rows.note: Use this for stressing an idea or point rather than literally marking text.

example.english: I want to underline that we can't delay this plan any longer.
example.traditional: 我想強調，呢個計劃唔可以再拖。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 koeng4 diu6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1
